arguments.value: Harry Sandlin Mattice Jr. (born 1954) is a retired U.S. District Judge for the Eastern District of Tennessee, serving from 2005 until assuming senior status in 2020 and retiring in 2021. Born in Chattanooga, Tennessee, he earned a B.S. from the University of Tennessee in 1976 and a J.D. from the University of Tennessee College of Law in 1981. He practiced privately in Tennessee from 1981 to 2001, served as senior counsel to the U.S. Senate Committee on Governmental Affairs in 1997, and was U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of Tennessee from 2001 to 2005 before his nomination to the federal bench by President George W. Bush.
